abstract: We describe a case of a 64-year-old woman with a malignant müllerian mixed tumor of the uterus containing a prominent component of yolk sac tumor, which was associated with high serum levels of alpha-fetoprotein. The neoplasm pursued an aggressive course and the patient died 2 months postoperatively. This is the first case of this type and only the ninth alpha-fetoprotein-secreting endometrial cancer in the literature.
abstract_ja: 64歳女性の子宮悪性ミュラー管混合腫瘍を報告する。卵黄嚢腫瘍の顕著な成分を含み、血清αフェトプロテイン(AFP)高値を伴っていた。腫瘍は侵攻性の経過をたどり、患者は術後2か月で死亡した。これはこの種の初めての症例であり、文献上9例目のαフェトプロテイン(AFP)産生子宮内膜癌である。
